is_free.a: Yes — browsing vendors and managing your event is free. You only pay your vendors directly through the platform.

vetted.a: Every vendor on Vendora is hand-selected by our editorial team. We review portfolios and references before approval.

events.q: What types of events does Vendora support?
events.a: Weddings, corporate events, milestone celebrations, private parties — anything that deserves to be done well.

payments.q: Can I manage payments through Vendora?
payments.a: Yes. Send deposits, schedule installments, and keep every receipt in one place.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Pick up where you left off.

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sent_trail: for a reset link. It'll expire in an hour.

signup.subtitle: Plan your event with vetted vendors.

customer.title: Customer
customer.tell_us_setup_desc: A two-minute setup so we can tailor your dashboard, recommendations, and pre-fill inquiries with your event details.

pending.title: Application under review
pending.body: While you wait, polish the listing — vendors with 5+ photos and 2+ priced packages get inquiries 2× faster the day they go live.

new_requests.body: Hosts who get a reply within 3 hours book ~3× more often than those who wait a day. Open the inbox and the AI-drafted reply is one click away.

views_no_inquiries.title: Hosts are looking, no one's reached out
views_no_inquiries.body: Listings with priced packages convert browsers into inquiries 2× more often than those that just say 'contact for pricing'. Add 2–3 tiers.

no_reviews.title: Import a few reviews
no_reviews.body: Past clients on The Knot, Yelp, or Google? Pasting 5–10 of those into Reviews makes new hosts trust you on day one.

ask_review.title: Ask your last booking for a review
ask_review.body: Auto-prompts go out 3 days after a booked event — but a personal nudge from you within the week lifts response rate ~40%.

share.title: Share your listing
share.body: Most vendors get their first booking from a referral, not the directory. A copy-paste link in your next Instagram caption beats any ad spend.

slow_response.title: Speed up your replies
slow_response.body: Your median response time is over 3 hours. Vendors who reply faster than that book ~3× more often. Templates in the inbox cut reply time in half.

low_views.title: Your listing isn't getting seen yet
low_views.body: Add a location, hero photo, and 5+ portfolio shots. Hosts filter the directory by location first; without one you're invisible to most searches.

great_funnel.title: Your funnel is humming
great_funnel.body: Conversion + reply time look great. Now it's a volume game — share the listing on social to push more inquiries through this same funnel.

header.subtitle: Vendor dashboard
header.application_pending_body: We'll get back to you within 2-3 business days. You can finish setting up your profile, packages, and photos while you wait — your listing goes live the moment it's approved.
header.application_rejected_default: Reach out to support if you'd like more detail.
header.setup_body: Hosts can't find you yet — finish your profile to start receiving inquiries.

recent.title: Recent inquiries
recent.empty: No inquiries yet — they'll appear here as hosts reach out.

vendor_analytics.title: Analytics
vendor_analytics.subtitle: Last {{days}} days · how hosts are finding + converting on you
vendor_analytics.no_profile_title: Set up your business profile first
vendor_analytics.no_profile_body: Once you have a vendor profile, your analytics will land here.

vendor_listing.title: Listing
vendor_listing.subtitle: Edit what hosts see when they open your listing
vendor_listing.category_hint: Pick the category that best matches your business — fields below are tailored to it.
vendor_listing.category_locked: Category is locked once your listing exists — delete the listing if you need to switch categories.
vendor_listing.category_nudge: Choose a category above to start building your listing. Pricing, packages, photos, team, reviews, and recommendations populate once you pick.
vendor_listing.short_bio_placeholder: One or two sentences about your style and approach.
vendor_listing.portfolio_placeholder: What makes your work distinctive? Notable clients, signature aesthetic, typical event size.
vendor_listing.intro_video_hint: YouTube, Vimeo, or a direct .mp4 link. Embeds at the top of your public profile.
vendor_listing.view_only: View only — ask the team owner to make changes.

preview.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? This removes your listing from the directory and cannot be undone.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Upload an image, describe the edit, get a new version back.
studio.upload_hint: PNG · JPG · WebP — up to 10 MB
studio.no_result_hint: Upload an image and describe the edit — the result lands here.
studio.prompt_placeholder: e.g. remove the background, replace with a warm gradient
studio.not_wired: Image editing isn't wired yet — connect a model provider (Replicate, Stability, OpenAI Edit) to enable this.

ai_agent.placeholder_body: Configure how the agent drafts replies, qualifies inquiries, and prices packages. Coming online soon.
